The '''Delrakkin system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Kallea sector/Legends|Kallea sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Delrakkin/Legends|Delrakkin]].
